name: WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund
oneLiner: WTGXX is WisdomTree's SEC-registered '40 Act government money market fund tokenized at a stable $1 NAV, with reserves in Treasuries, repos, and cash.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills, Treasury floating-rate notes, and tri-party repurchase agreements held by the WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund (renamed from WisdomTree Government Money Market Digital Fund on 2025-11-01); a Rule 2a-7 '40 Act-registered money market fund managed by WisdomTree Digital Management with Voya Investment Management as sub-adviser, recorded natively on-chain via the WisdomTree Connect platform
pegMechanism: $1.00 stable NAV money market share; SEC-approved 24/7 dealer trading at fixed $1 intraday (Feb 2026); primary subscription and redemption are gated to WisdomTree Connect users with USDC dealer settlement and USD-wire alternatives

applicabilityBasis.summary: WTGXX is a share class of a Rule 2a-7-registered Investment Company Act of 1940 money market fund (WisdomTree Treasury Money Market Digital Fund), making it a security under federal securities laws. The GENIUS Act (Public Law 119-27, signed July 18, 2025) explicitly excludes from the payment stablecoin definition any digital asset that is a security as defined in section 2 of the Securities Act of 1933, section 3 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, or section 2 of the Investment Company Act of 1940. WTGXX is not marketed as a payment instrument — it is positioned as a qualifying GENIUS Act reserve asset for payment stablecoin issuers, not as a payment stablecoin itself.

genius.notes: WTGXX is outside GENIUS Act payment-stablecoin tracking because it is a digital share class of a Rule 2a-7-registered money market fund — a security explicitly excluded from the GENIUS Act's definition of 'payment stablecoin' (Public Law 119-27, sec. 2(a), signed July 18, 2025). WTGXX's role under the GENIUS Act is as a qualifying reserve asset for stablecoin issuers (the fund restructured its portfolio by November 2025 to hold only Treasuries ≤93 days and overnight repos, meeting GENIUS Act reserve requirements). WisdomTree separately launched USDW (previously WUSD), a distinct payment stablecoin issued by WisdomTree Digital Trust Company, a New York-chartered trust — USDW is the entity that may eventually pursue GENIUS Act authorization as a permitted payment stablecoin issuer; WTGXX is not that entity.

mintAuthority.summary: WTGXX minting is gated by REGISTRAR_ROLE (keccak256 = 0xedcc084d...) across all EVM chains. Confirmed REGISTRAR_ROLE = EOA 0x726D3b3e... and DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x6257759e... on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, and Plume. Stellar issuer has 2 signers (weights 255+50, thresholds 25/50/150) confirming centralized issuer model.

controls.label: WTGXX REGISTRAR_ROLE holder (all EVM chains)

controls.label: WTGXX DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder (all EVM chains)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, eth_getCode confirms EOA (no bytecode). hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x0000..., 0x6257759e...) = true on Ethereum (RoleGranted logs), Arbitrum (RoleGranted logs), Base (hasRole call), and Optimism (hasRole call) — same EOA holds DEFAULT_ADMIN on all verified EVM chains.

review.evidence: REGISTRAR_ROLE = keccak256('REGISTRAR_ROLE') = 0xedcc084d... confirmed as the mint role from AccessControl.sol source. At block 25295081 (ETH) / 47200982 (Base): EOA 0x726d3b3e... holds REGISTRAR_ROLE on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, Plume (hasRole calls all return true). EOA 0x6257759e... holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on all EVM chains. Both EOAs confirmed no-bytecode. Stellar account GDMBNMFJ... has 2 signers (weights 255+50), thresholds 25/50/150, auth_required+auth_revocable+clawback — consistent with centralized issuer model.
